Questions brides ask

Before you say yes.

How early should I order?

As soon as your date is set. Standard delivery is 7 to 14 days depending on the song, and you'll want time to hear it, request changes, and get it to your DJ. If your wedding is close, choose rush delivery.

What if I don't love it?

Every song includes revisions: 1 for Before She Walks, 2 for The Walk, and 3 for Our First Dance. You'll hear your song before your wedding day and we adjust it until it feels like you.

Will the lyrics be church-appropriate?

Yes. Every song is clean, with no profanity or explicit content. Gospel and inspirational styles are available if you want faith woven into your song.

Can my DJ or venue play it?

Yes. You receive MP3 and WAV files, plus a DJ-ready version with The Walk and above. Just hand them the files.

Can I give this as a surprise to my fiancé?

Absolutely. Fill out the workbook with what you know, and tell me it's a surprise. Our First Dance can include his side of the story if you'd like to ask him a few questions quietly.

Can I post my song online?

Your song is yours to play at your wedding, in your wedding video, and on your social media. Songwriting credit stays with the writer.
